findings.title: Silence action is displayed but cannot open a drawer for Prometheus-only list items
findings.body: The new GrafanaRuleListItem supplies only promRule, so rule is undefined in this component. AlertRuleMenu now correctly grants the Silence menu item from the Prometheus rule ability and clicking it sets showSilenceDrawer, but the drawer is rendered only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. With no ruler rule this condition is always false, so selecting “Silence notifications” has no effect in the new list view.

findings.title: Pause is unavailable for Grafana rules rendered without a ruler response
findings.body: canPause includes the new Grafana Prometheus-rule ability, but the actual pause menu item additionally requires rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule). The new list item intentionally passes no rulerRule, so even an authorized user with a pausable Grafana Prometheus rule never sees the Pause/Resume action. This regresses rule pausing in the ruler-free list view.

findings.title: Delete is hidden for Grafana rules in the ruler-free list view
findings.body: canDelete now includes permissions derived from promRule, but Delete is still rendered only when rulerRule is present. GrafanaRuleListItem passes only a Prometheus rule, therefore authorized users cannot delete any Grafana-managed rule from the new alert list even though the delete modal already receives a usable identifier and group identifier.

findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: The previous ability implementation checked isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) before enabling update/delete/pause actions. The refactored ruler-only function no longer receives the group and hard-codes isFederated to false. Consequently federated external rule groups can expose edit, delete, pause, and related controls whenever other permissions permit them, despite the prior behavior explicitly marking them immutable.

findings.title: Grafana rule list elements no longer have React keys
findings.body: This branch is produced inside rules.map but GrafanaRuleListItem is rendered without key={key}, unlike the datasource and unknown branches and unlike the previous GrafanaRuleLoader. React will treat these rows as unkeyed siblings, producing warnings and allowing row-local state (such as open action UI) to be associated with the wrong rule when the result list changes.
